name: ProWebExp – Content Sync & Duplicator
author: Saubhik M

sections.description:
ProWebExp – Content Sync & Duplicator provides two duplication and synchronization modes:

  • Single Site: duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types directly from their list tables.
  • Multisite: duplicate and synchronize posts, pages, and custom post types from one network site to another.

In Multisite mode, the plugin can copy content between network sites, including custom fields, taxonomies, post metadata, featured images, and images stored inside custom-field values.

The plugin copies post content, taxonomies, post meta, featured images, and attachment IDs stored inside nested custom-field values.

Features

  • Single-site post duplicator.
  • Multisite cross-site synchronization.
  • Custom post type support.
  • Taxonomy and term synchronization.
  • Post meta/custom field synchronization.
  • Recursive custom-field processing.
  • Featured image copying.
  • Images inside arrays, galleries, repeaters, groups, and similar nested values.
  • Destination media mapping to prevent repeated imports.
  • Existing cross-site synced posts are updated instead of duplicated.
  • Uses WordPress capability checks and nonces.

Notes

For ACF and other custom-field systems, the plugin processes stored post-meta recursively. Image IDs that resolve to WordPress attachments are imported into the destination Media Library and replaced with destination attachment IDs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the prowebexp-content-sync-duplicator folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. On a single site, use the Duplicate action from a post/page/custom post type list.
  4. On Multisite, use ProWebExp in Network Admin for cross-site synchronization.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added single-site post duplication.
  • Added Multisite content synchronization.
  • Added recursive media/custom-field handling.
